extractions.description: Empirical scaling study of molecular graph neural networks, including supervised pretraining, finetuning, fingerprint probing, and the contributed MolGPS graph foundation model.

type.quote: We study the scaling behavior of 2D molecular GNNs under varied settings of depth, width, number of molecules, number of labels, the diversity in dataset, and the architectural choice.
type.justification: The paper reports extensive training and evaluation experiments.
